body.statement:
Construct \(\mathfrak A\) to complete the exceptional classification not covered by the principal real charts.  First, for the cubic map \((\pi,h,r,t,w,x,y,z,u,v)\mapsto C_{\pi}^{(3)}(h,r,t,w,x,y,z,u,v)\), partition
\[
\bigsqcup_{\pi\in\mathfrak S_3}\{\pi\}\times
\bigl(\mathbb R^9\setminus\Theta_{\pi}^{\circ}\bigr)
\]
into finitely many semialgebraic strata on which the real fiber cardinality and the set of compatible chain orders are certified and constant.  On every singleton-order stratum, give observable rational formulas for \(u\) and \(v\); on every non-singleton or positive-dimensional stratum, give explicit real parameter twins or a fiber parameterization.  Second, without conflating this six-order cubic problem with the fixed published graph, stratify the exceptional complement of the analytically certified localized chart \(W_2^{\mathrm{el}}\ne0\) for the observed-moment fibers underlying \(\widetilde\Phi_{\le3}\), recording all compatible values of \(\beta\).  On all intersections of slice-rank, kernel-coordinate, adjugate-denominator, and localization-denominator hypersurfaces, decide whether failure of the displayed \(\operatorname{Rec}\) branch is removable by an alternate chart or reflects genuine nonidentification in the relevant cubic or full second-and-third-moment map.
body.justification: This exposes the genuine unresolved content instead of equating one failed rational denominator with structural ambiguity.
body.gap: Generic elimination in Tramontano et al. (2025) and Garcia-Puente et al. (2010) does not classify real fibers on exceptional intersections; Drton, Foygel, and Sullivant (2011) do not cover this higher-moment latent LiNGAM map.
body.consumer: A completed atlas yields exact ambiguity warnings and alternate formulas for observations near every failure divisor of the cubic branch.

obligation.what_is_open: A finite real semialgebraic atlas on every intersection in the complement of the six principal cubic charts, together with the exceptional real fibers of the exact fixed published full second-and-third-moment map.
obligation.obstruction: The proved product and sign chart does not determine real primary components when several factors vanish. Alternate adjugate columns can remove some failures, whereas a full-moment ambiguity requires covariance-compatible twins; neither follows from denominator vanishing alone.
obligation.attempted: The principal arbitrary-real chart was solved exactly. A removable fixed-order zero-column boundary and a genuine cubic zero-skew coefficient fiber were also derived, but they do not enumerate all intersections or settle covariance compatibility.
obligation.partial_result:
The principal part is closed.  For every order \(\pi\), the theorem on \(\Theta_{\pi}^{\circ}\) proves that the root slice has rank two, both nonroot slices are nonsingular, the signed kernel identifies the middle label, \(W_bD\ne0\), and the two adjugate ratios recover \((u,v)\); equality of two principal-chart tensors forces equality of their order and both coefficients.  The cubic image \(\{C_3(P):P\in\mathcal P_+\}\) of the compact class is contained in \(\mathcal C^\circ\) and additionally has the stated uniform margins.  On the exceptional complement, the fixed-order boundary \(y=0\), \(hxrtz\ne0\), has a removable adjugate-column failure with
\[
v=\frac{(M_bk)_c}{(M_bk)_b},
\qquad
u=-\frac{k_a}{k_b+vk_c},
\]
whereas \(r=0\) has a genuine cubic coefficient fiber because \(u'=u+\Delta\), \(y'=y-x\Delta\) preserves \(C_{\pi}^{(3)}\) for every \(\Delta\ne0\).  The latter witness does not yet give a covariance-compatible twin for the full second-and-third-moment map.  What remains is the finite all-intersection real stratification, the alternate charts on every removable component, and explicit full-moment twins or parameterizations on every genuinely nonidentified component.
